predicted_reason: These door impact beams are classified under Chapter 73 of the HTSUS, which covers iron and steel products. Section 19 specifies that hot-rolled steel pipes fall under this category. The product meets the requirements of being an 'alloy steel pipe' with specific dimensions and coatings for surface treatment and rust prevention.
